description: The overlay, aim-card and tray-panel webviews: event listening ONLY (audit P0-5 follow-up — they used to share the main window's full core surface). Evidence: overlay/main.ts and aimcard.ts use convertFileSrc (pure JS URL building) plus __TAURI__.event.listen; tray/main.ts touches no Tauri API at all (its action button rides the app-level tray_panel_action command, which the ACL does not govern). Positioning, show/hide and all window mutations for these windows happen on the Rust side, outside the ACL.
